title: Estée Lauder unveils ‘breakthrough’ platform to accelerate skin science and longevity innovations
summary: Estée Lauder Companies’ new Mastering Skin Longevity platform claims to look beyond the study of individual hallmarks of ageing by placing the focus on the ‘master regulators of skin longevity’, helping to advance skin science for brands The Ordinary, Clinique, La Mer and Dr.Jart+
